title: A normalized bivariate Arb jet carries the compact full-Fisher integral through third parameter order
method: Represent t and z by normalized total-degree-three bivariate Arb jets, propagate all ten coefficients through the positive-denominator mixture density, and integrate each coefficient with the certified 352-cell order-12 observation-coordinate Taylor rule on [-11,11].
scope_guard: K1801 certifies the compact-window third-order parameter derivatives at the named rational checkpoint and supplies the reusable centered-model engine. Whole-line use still requires K1786-style omitted-tail composition, and no box, slab or global theorem follows from a point jet alone.
